capture: Real pnpm 11.7.0 --reporter=ndjson stdout. The tarball case uses a frozen picocolors@1.1.1 lockfile and empty Store. Metadata uses --no-frozen-lockfile and an empty metadata cache to reach the resolver. Script runs a failing root preinstall that prints cache-error JSON. Permission and disk inject EACCES/ENOSPC at fs.promises.mkdir for the fixture Store; the unmodified pnpm reporter emits the errors. Lockfile uses --frozen-lockfile without a lockfile. Only timestamps, hostnames, PIDs and temporary/package-install paths are normalized. Warm stdout is a successful frozen offline install of the same locked picocolors package from an already populated Store.
